scoredQuestions.text: How does your company decide whether to invest in a new AI tool or solution?

options.label: Individual staff or departments choose their own AI tools based on needs
AI tools are adopted based on competitor practices, market trends or vendor recommendations
AI tools are evaluated against identified operational challenges or business opportunities before adoption
AI tools are selected according to a business roadmap with defined objectives, measures and implementation plans

scoredQuestions.text: Where are most business data and documents stored today?

options.label: Stored across individual devices, personal clouds or paper files
Stored in several separate shared drives or cloud storage platforms
Stored in company shared drives or cloud storage platforms
Stored in different drives and cloud systems but are connected and can be accessed or used across functions without manual consolidation

scoredQuestions.text: How would you describe the quality and consistency of business data used across your company?

options.label: Data is often incomplete, duplicated or outdated
Basic records are maintained, but data varies between departments
Most business data is systematically stored and up-to-date, and updated manually by different teams
Business data is automatically maintained and updated using standard processes and strict controls across the company

scoredQuestions.text: How widely is AI used across different parts of your business?

options.label: Used within one department or business function
Used across several departments or business functions
Used across most departments and business functions, including customer-facing, operational and administrative teams

scoredQuestions.text: Which statement best reflects the role AI plays in your company today?

options.label: AI mainly helps staff complete individual tasks faster (Examples: translation, drafting emails, searching information)
AI helps teams produce work more efficiently (Examples: presentations, proposals, reports, marketing content)
AI supports day-to-day business processes (Examples: customer and sales analysis, reporting & forecasting)
AI automates workflows and helps coordinate work across people, systems and departments (Examples: customer enquiry workflows, staff onboarding processes, report compilation)

scoredQuestions.text: Which statement best describes how your company manages the use of AI tools?

options.label: No company rules or requirements currently exist
Basic guidance is provided, such as what information should or should not be entered into AI tools
Written guidelines define acceptable AI usage, responsibilities and approval requirements for higher-risk tasks
Formal governance framework is in place, with designated ownership, documented policies, approval processes and regular review

scoredQuestions.text: Approximately what percentage of employees use AI tools as part of their daily work?
Approximately what percentage of employees have received AI-related training or coaching in the past 12 months?
What is the most significant business benefit AI has delivered so far?

options.label: Improved employee productivity (Examples: less time spent on content creation, research, reporting)
Improved operational efficiency (Examples: faster turnaround, fewer manual processes, improved service response)
Contributed to revenue growth, customer acquisition, service innovation or business expansion

scoredQuestions.text: How does management currently measure the value created by AI?

options.label: Feedback is mainly based on employee observations or anecdotal examples
Specific fields such as productivity, turnaround time or service quality are identified and reviewed periodically
Management tracks AI-related business outcomes using defined metrics or KPIs

qualitativeQuestions.text: What is currently the biggest obstacle preventing your company from getting more value from AI?

options.label: We are satisfied with our current level of AI adoption
Lack of employee skills, expertise or implementation support
Uncertain how to identify and implement the right AI solutions

qualitativeQuestions.text: Which statement best reflects your company's AI goals over the next 12 months?

options.label: Expand AI usage within selected teams or functions
Deploy AI across multiple departments and business processes
Transform key business workflows using AI

tiers.label: AI Accelerator
tiers.description: Your company demonstrates a mature and structured approach to AI adoption, with AI supporting both operational performance and business objectives. The next step is to accelerate innovation, automate higher-value workflows and explore new growth opportunities enabled by AI.

tiers.label: AI Builder
tiers.description: Your company has established a solid AI foundation, supported by growing adoption and business improvements. Focus can now shift towards connecting processes, scaling successful use cases and driving more consistent business outcomes.

tiers.label: AI Adopter
tiers.description: Your company has started applying AI in selected areas and is seeing initial benefits. The next opportunity is to expand adoption across teams, strengthen governance and align AI initiatives more closely with business priorities to unlock greater value.

tiers.label: AI Explorer
tiers.description: Your company is at the early stage of its AI journey, with AI usage largely driven by individual initiatives and limited integration into business operations. Building a clearer adoption strategy and identifying practical use cases can help create a stronger foundation for future growth.

scoredQuestions.text: 公司如何決定投資新的 AI 工具或方案？

options.label: 員工或部門按個別需要自行選用 AI 工具
主要根據同業做法、市場趨勢或供應商建議採用 AI 工具
在採用前，會因應已識別的營運挑戰或業務機遇作評估
根據已制定的業務發展路線圖，按既定目標、衡量指標及推行計劃選用 AI 方案

scoredQuestions.text: 現時公司有主要存放業務資料及文件於什麼地方？

options.label: 分散存放於個人裝置、個人雲端空間或紙本文件
分散存放於不同共用硬碟或雲端儲存平台
集中存放於公司共用硬碟或雲端儲存平台
毋須人手整合，存放於已互相連接的系統及雲端平台，並可跨部門存取及使用

scoredQuestions.text: 以下哪一項最接近公司管理業務數據的情況？

options.label: 數據經常出現缺漏、重複或過時情況
已建立基本紀錄，但各部門存放數據紀錄參差
大部分業務數據有系統地保持更新，由不同團隊定期人手維護
透過既定流程及嚴謹管理機制，自動維護及更新業務數據

scoredQuestions.text: 以下哪一項最接近公司應用 AI 的情況？

options.label: 主要於單一部門或業務職能內應用
已於部份部門或業務職能應用
已於大部分業務及職能，包括前線營運、後勤支援及行政管理廣泛應用

scoredQuestions.text: 以下哪一項最能反映 AI 在公司的角色？

options.label: 主要協助員工提升個人工作效率（例如：翻譯、撰寫電郵、搜尋資料）
主要協助團隊更有效地完成工作（例如：製作簡報、建議書、報告或市場推廣內容）
支援日常業務流程（例如：客戶及銷售分析、報告製作、業務預測）
用於自動化工作流程及協調跨部門工作（例如：客戶查詢處理流程、新員工入職流程、報告整合）

scoredQuestions.text: 以下哪一項最能反映公司如何管理員工使用 AI 工具？

options.label: 目前沒有任何相關規定或要求
已提供基本指引，例如哪些資料適合或不適合輸入 AI 工具
已制定書面指引，涵蓋可接受的 AI 使用方式、責任分工及較高風險工作的審批要求
已建立正式管治框架，包括專責人員、書面政策、審批程序及定期檢討機制

scoredQuestions.text: 在日常工作中，公司約有多少比例的員工使用 AI 工具？
過去 12 個月內，公司約有多少員工曾接受 AI 相關培訓或指導？
公司由開始採用 AI 至今，AI 為公司帶來最顯著的業務效益是甚麼？

options.label: 暫未有實際可量度的效益
提升員工工作效率（例如：減少內容製作、資料搜集及報告準備時間）
提升營運效率（例如：縮短處理時間、減少人手工序、改善服務回應速度）
促進業務增長（例如：增加收入機會、拓展客戶、推動服務創新或業務發展）

scoredQuestions.text: 現時管理層如何評估 AI 所創造的價值？

options.label: 主要根據員工意見或個別案例作判斷
已就生產力、處理時間或服務質素等範疇定期檢視
透過已制定的指標或 KPI 持續追蹤 AI 帶來的業務成果

qualitativeQuestions.text: 有甚麼主要因素令公司未有更廣泛地採用 AI？

options.label: 現有 AI 應用水平已符合業務需要
缺乏相關技能、專業知識或推行支援
不清楚如何選擇及落實合適的 AI 方案

qualitativeQuestions.text: 以未來 12 個月計，以下哪一項最能反映公司的 AI 發展目標？

options.label: 維持現有 AI 應用水平
擴展 AI 應用至指定團隊或職能
在多個部門及業務流程中推行 AI
利用 AI 改變關鍵業務流程

tiers.label: AI 加速者
tiers.description: 公司已具備成熟及有系統的 AI 應用能力，並有效支援業務營運及發展目標。下一步可聚焦於推動創新、自動化更高價值的工作流程，以及發掘新的業務增長機會。

tiers.label: AI 建設者
tiers.description: 公司已建立穩健的 AI 應用基礎，並在業務運作上取得實際成果。未來可進一步透過 AI 整合不同流程、擴展成功應用案例及提升自動化水平，以推動更一致及可持續的業務效益。

tiers.label: AI 採用者
tiers.description: 公司已開始於部分範疇應用 AI，並看見初步成效。下一步可考慮將 AI 應用擴展至更多團隊及業務流程，同時加強管治及協作機制，以釋放 AI 可帶來更大的業務價值。

tiers.label: AI 探索者
tiers.description: 公司正處於 AI 應用的起步階段，現有應用主要集中於個別員工應用層面，有空間將 AI 應用整合至業務流程。透過建立更清晰的應用方向及發掘合適的業務場景，可為未來擴展 AI 應用帶來更穩固基礎。
